topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Well, you wouldn't believe the morning I just had! I stepped out with my coffee, and what do I see? My car's gone, vanished from my driveway! At first, I was just puzzled, thinking maybe I'd parked in a really odd spot and forgotten. But then the neighbor told me it was towed away. Can you imagine? I had to walk to the shop, just to get a ride to the tow yard. But you know what? It's a beautiful day, and I had a great chat with a local I might not have met otherwise. Plus, I found a fun new shortcut home. Life's little surprises!
